sourceInformation.source: Space Fortress (Century Electronics / CVS, 1981). Original interpretation; not the Astrocade or cognitive-training games.
sourceInformation.perspective: Overhead free flight and fortress defense; side-view horizontal ground line.
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge 0.89.1 (8ecc2f62353761187bdfe226f327b7ea5d2eb691), JavaScript, Canvas 2D, Web Audio, AI Hub client 1.4.0 / protocol v1.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Custom procedural shaded pixel ships, mechanical fortress panels, cyan and copper light, star-chart presentation.
sourceInformation.animation: Native E.anim sprite frames/rotation, native easing and tween-driven victory flyout, plus simulation-driven recoil, shields, gravity, radiator cooling, sliding boss shutters, docking and retreat.
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-composed military synth motifs, laser/impact/gravity/warning SFX and synthesized gibberish radio on separate engine buses. Music defaults to 10%.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub authoritative shared-world co-op for 1–4, including dedicated host; standalone couch co-op for 2–4.
sourceInformation.testing: Unrestricted headless testing with no FPS target. 51 checks: fixed-step simulation, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, synthetic standard pads, phone/tablet touch, offline Web Audio and the official adverse-network Hub harness. Physical controllers, actual iOS, public internet hosting and human listening quality: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Visually inspected the Century flyer and six sampled gameplay frames; read the Museum of the Game entry, MAME CVS driver, engine handoff/API/ROCKS kit and current Hub client/README/example/harness/checker. Original music and exact scoring: unknown. Full links and revisions in development docs/research.md.

testingFeedback: 14 unique game defects found and fixed; test-tool errors and review-only corrections are excluded. The verifier passes 51 checks.
1 critical runtime issue: a recursive credits Back callback. It is fixed and navigation is covered by the browser suite.
The no-cheat full siege across every upgrade branch. It exposed ground-base damage that made the longer non-laser boss fights lose.
The initial title-only smoke check. It helped composition but said little about combat, progression or multiplayer.
engineFeedback: The native pixel shading, sprite animation, procedural audio buses and controller-navigable Shell fit this arcade game well.
I gave a Shell Back callback another call to Back, causing recursion. A real credits-navigation test found it; native stack navigation fixed it.
A deterministic three-act siege simulation, authored director and authoritative co-op replication with recoverable bounded snapshots.
Coordinating the fixed arena, portrait HUD and a host clock that keeps running while a local menu or hidden-tab timer interrupts rendering.
None to the released engine. It is bundled unchanged; game-specific Shell subclasses, input adapters and scheduling use its public systems.
Include a tested shared-world authority clock and compact snapshot example in the handoff.
promptFeedback: The complete vertical-slice goal, source research and concrete single-file hand-in contract.
Space Fortress names several unrelated games; PLAN.md resolves the interpretation to Century Electronics / CVS.
Making three connected defensive acts, every upgrade branch, controller/touch UX and authoritative co-op obey one state model.
Include the pinned engine and Hub handoffs with the task, and distinguish required acceptance gates from optional examples.

aiHub.name: Space Fortnight
aiHub.description: Pilot Viper wing through a siege of Fortress 13. Break the outer screen, keep the radiators breathing, and become the last gun on the ground against the Night Admiral.
aiHub.controls: WASD / left stick: thrust; mouse / right stick: aim; left click / R2: fire; Space / L2: boost; E / right click / Square: pulse; Escape / Options: menu. Touch: left thumb thrust, right drag aim and fire.
